title: Pupacyst
extract:
The Pupacyst is an  Infested polearm that innately deals  Viral damage.

Characteristics
This weapon deals both  Viral and  Impact damage.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Shimmering Blight and  Argent Scourge (Conclave only) stance.
Innate  polarity.
Advantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
High total damage (284)
Above average block angle (55°)
Above average follow through (0.6x)
Above average attack range (2.70 m)
High disposition (●●●●● (1.35x))
Slam Attack (wiki attack index 2)
High total damage (568)
Above average block angle (55°)
Above average follow through (0.6x)
Above average attack range (2.70 m)
High status chance (29.00%)
High disposition (●●●●● (1.35x))
Heavy Slam Attack (wiki attack index 3)
Very high total damage (852)
Above average block angle (55°)
Above average follow through (0.6x)
Above average damage × attack speed (755.84)
Above average attack range (2.70 m)
Very high status chance (37.00%)
High disposition (●●●●● (1.35x))
Disadvantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Tied with  Orthos and  Serro for the second lowest critical multiplier of all polearms, after  Cassowar.
Tied with  Kesheg and  Guandao for the slowest attack speed of all polearms.
Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Low crit chance (13.00%)
Very low attack speed (0.833x animation speed)
Very low crit multiplier (1.50x)
Slam Attack (wiki attack index 2)
Low crit chance (13.00%)

Very low crit multiplier (1.50x)
Heavy Slam Attack (wiki attack index 3)
Low crit chance (13.00%)
Very low attack speed (0.833x animation speed)
Very low crit multiplier (1.50x)
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

Acquisition
The Pupacyst's blueprint can be researched from the Bio Lab in the dojo.

Trivia
Although the Pupacyst's description claims that its tip "rends flesh", it has no  Slash damage whatsoever.
